Container.Name: investigatarr
Container.Overview: Checks your Unraid server's security and gives it a score out of 100, with a fix for every finding. Looks at management access (Telnet, HTTP, UPnP, SSH, FTP), passwords and password reuse, SMB and NFS shares, Docker containers, VMs and exposed services. Read-only: it mounts the host read-only and needs no Docker socket and no privileged mode. Free forever: no paid tiers, no Pro account, no subscriptions.

Config.Name: Host root (read-only)
Config.Description: Your server's filesystem, mounted read-only so Investigatarr can read its settings. Do not make this writable.

Config.Name: Reports
Config.Description: Where the report page and report.json are saved

Config.Name: Scan interval (hours)
Config.Description: Rescan every N hours. 0 runs once and stops.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the report page (host networking, so pick a free port)
